reviews.text:
100% service
The groomer was calm and tranquil, passing that same calmness on to the pet. I recommend her.
The best, always.

I have no words to describe the care and affection the team has for my boys. They are excellent professionals, I trust them completely. As a pet mom, I feel very reassured knowing they are being well cared for and loved. I want to commend Ana, an excellent professional who takes care of them as if they were her own.
Terrible customer service via WhatsApp; they take ages to respond.

Bad... I called in advance to schedule an appointment for my dog ​​a week ago, yesterday I confirmed the grooming and bath, and NO ONE WARNED ME ABOUT THE PROBLEM WITH THE GROOMER. Then today, 40 minutes before the appointment, I received a message saying that the groomer was bitten yesterday... imagine, I was only notified today... I scheduled at one address, then they sent me a message telling me to go to another address, okay... I asked to reschedule for Tuesday, but there are no available times, only for Wednesday, meaning I'm being cancelled due to a possible problem (because, given how things were handled, I doubt it's true) and I still don't have priority for service... then, to explain the problem, they said I didn't send the vaccination card, that I was going to present it at the time, that's easy to solve, I just forgot... in other words, if the intention is to justify it with this talk about the vaccination card, it won't work because today, after this problem, they remembered the card... I understand... well, the disorganization is huge, imagine the service. My dog ​​has ZERO CONFIDENCE... I always believe in the best service and the best way to handle things, but I didn't feel any sincerity in anything... I can't recommend a place that doesn't value the organization of information with the owner... imagine what they'd do to my dog...

I took my Yorkshire Terrier to the groomer with some tangles and without any hope of saving her; in my mind, the only option was a haircut.
But after a detailed assessment by Aunt Ju, she saw the possibility of keeping the coat.
I'm sure the work was done with a lot of care and dedication; my little dog looks beautiful with her coat hydrated and soft, without any tangles.
Aunt Ju is very attentive.
She's gained a customer; I recommend her.

I have a Shih Tzu who suffers from dermatitis. They are always patient during baths because they need to dry her with less heat. The staff is loving, attentive, and they've never made a mistake with a grooming session. My Shih Tzu loves daycare too. You can trust them ❤️

Leaving our pet in your care gives us peace of mind knowing he's being very well looked after!
Quality service, attention, and care for our "BB" (as they call our MIG).
All the services we use always leave us very satisfied. Bathing is top-notch, daycare is great for him because he always comes back "exhausted" from playing so much in the space that's totally prepared for pets, and every time we need to travel for longer periods we leave him there; we're always very reassured knowing he's being well cared for by qualified professionals.

Elinton and Ju are experts when it comes to pets.
Highly recommend!!

Thank you Benmpets family.

Look at the face of someone who loves this place 😍
100% trustworthy, I've been taking my dogs there for years!

Very good! I recommend them!

Super attentive.
The best place to take care of your pet, lots of attention and care, with the love of my life.
They are very affectionate and dedicated.
Excellent
I've already used their bathing and boarding services. Excellent service and care for our pets!! 1000/1000!!
Great place, excellent service, and the staff are very caring with the pets. I've been taking my baby Algodão there for 4 years now.
It's the only place I trust to take my dog. They're so sweet, always very kind and helpful. I wouldn't trade it for anything! ❤️

I'd like to express my praise for the grooming service at this pet groomer's place, Jussara. I confess I was impressed by the care, love, and respect she showed my pet. Jussara is so kind and lovely; she truly has a gift for caring for animals. Furthermore, no pet groomer ever asked for my vaccination record; they asked everything about my pet. I found that fantastic, as no other groomer has ever asked me that, and I've been to many! Ju, thank you so much for your excellent work and your love for animals. May God bless you in everything. Congratulations! 🎈🎉🍾 ❤️❤️❤️❤️🐾🐾🐾🐾
Thank you 🙌🏻 …

Think of someone who loves what they do? That's Ju! I highly recommend her work as a "petsitter"!
She was extremely careful and affectionate with my four-legged "children."

This same attitude and care also applies to her bathing and grooming services. I highly recommend her!!!! 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
They are very good, very caring and excellent professionals. The boarding is very good, I leave my pet there whenever I need to, he loves staying there.
Nobody answers

Here the feedback is in the MILLIONS!
I love the service and care that Ju has for my baby, and for me. Thank you, the best choice was meeting you.
Very good, they are attentive and caring with my pet, and the bathing is always impeccable. The place is new (I was a client before the change) but it's becoming very beautiful and functional. …
I highly recommend them! I loved the service I received and the care and affection they showed my Blue. I will definitely be back. Excellent work.
An excellent place for grooming and bathing your pet. I also highly recommend the daycare. …
She takes great care of my babies, I highly recommend her ❤️
